name: Avelorn
role: Region capital: services, quest hub, crafting, transit to Lumeris fields and Sylvara.

name: Dawnmeadow
role: First field: two gentle swarms, passive and assisting, on open ground; learn to pull and AoE.

name: Amber Trail
role: A long trail east then north: resin thickets, a glider hollow and a mite-infested rock outcrop.

name: Whispergrass
role: North of Avelorn: tall-grass plains with a rune circle; the first bruiser field.

name: Old Windmill
role: Mid-region hub field with a rest camp; the Dustwing swarm is Lumeris's signature horde.

name: Moonbrook
role: A brook running north-south; amphibians on the banks, ranged hunters in the marsh.

name: Broken Orchard
role: The region's last field: dense rot hordes, a rot-choked pump house, and the cave down to Hollowroot.

name: Hollowroot Cavern
role: Lumeris's dungeon: root tunnels and an Aethrion pump hall around the Warden's Heart Chamber.

name: Sylvara
role: Region capital among the roots of the Mother Bough: services, quest hub, crafting, transit to Verdantis fields, Avelorn and Duskhar.

name: Fernreach
role: First Verdantis field: passive Graftling herds everywhere, in the hollow, the tapped groves, by the stream and in the grafting ruins.

name: Mossbridge
role: A creek valley crossed by two moss-grown Aethrion bridges: newt banks south and by the obelisk, drone hives north and on the north-west slope.

name: Canopy Steps
role: Three terraces cut into a giant trunk and joined by Aethrion lift-ramps: hounds below, moths mid-way, moths and hounds again on top.

name: Graftwood
role: An Aethrion grafting orchard overrun by Vinecrawlers: trellis rows, the stalled grafting yard and wild graft-stock woods to the south.

name: Vineworks
role: The Aethrion vine-press works: Tender terraces and conduits, hare-grazed vine slopes and Thistlehare warrens round the old water pump.

name: Elderroot
role: The oldest trees in Verdantis, their roots fused with Aethrion conduits: Root Sentinels on the ridges, in the old warrens and on the Basin slope, and the Antlered Engines' glade.

name: Spore Basin
role: A sunken basin under the Heartwood Engine's vents, given over to Sporebloats: dense hordes under the vents, round the obelisk, by the spore pool and at the Engine's mouth.

name: Heartwood Engine
role: Verdantis's dungeon: the sap conduits, piston hall and spore lung of the Aethrion engine that drives the forest, round the Regent's heart chamber.

name: Duskhar
role: Region capital on an Aethrion canal: services, quest hub, crafting, transit to Solenia's fields, Sylvara and Port Merrow.

name: Saffron Dunes
role: First Solenia field: basking Sandcoils on the crests and the mesa glass, a jackal pack at the oasis and a buried pipeline where both meet.

name: Caravan Verge
role: The caravan crossroads round a ruined caravanserai: kites over the heights and the old checkpoint, glass scarabs in the washes and west of the serai.

name: Glass Flats
role: A plain of lightning-fused glass under heliograph mirrors: Sentry fields, basilisk packs, and sentries and basilisks round the mirrors and the glass scar.

name: Sun Dial
role: A colossal Aethrion sundial: Wardens and Acolytes on its face, Acolyte sands, a Warden causeway and a graveyard of broken sentries the Acolytes tend.

name: Dust Aqueduct
role: A ruined aqueduct over the last canal water: Canal Striders on the channel, round the piers, in the dry sluices and at the cistern.

name: Buried Causeway
role: A raised Aethrion causeway half-swallowed by sand, leading to the Vault's sealed door: Revenants on the road, Lens-drones over the sinks, Colossi in the sand, a lens array at the door.

name: Heliostat Vault
role: Solenia's dungeon: a sealed vault of mirrors and lenses that focuses the desert sun, round the Sovereign's core chamber.

name: Port Merrow
role: Region capital: harbour services, quest hub, crafting, the ferry to Tidewheel Bay and transit to Solenia and Crystallis.

name: Saltwind Shore
role: First field: a long beach under gull cliffs; a passive herd in the tidepools, the first aggressive flock and the first bruisers.

name: Coral Reach
role: A reef left high by the tide, crossed on Aethrion boardwalks: Polyp Spitters rooted on every coral head, the region's ranged lesson.

name: Tidewheel Bay
role: A horseshoe bay ringed by giant tidewheels: pump constructs on the pumps and pilings, Kelp Tenders in the beds and on the barnacled paddles; the ferry from Port Merrow lands here.

name: Wreck Shoal
role: Sandbars strewn with wrecks and a sunken Aethrion freighter: the Hullborer horde in every hull, buoy and driftwood bar.

name: Pearl Flats
role: Mudflats and pearl beds under a relay mast: fleeing skates in the beds and ruins, the relay's guardians on the mast and the strand.

name: Stormbreak
role: The storm-lashed headland at the region's edge: Squall Rays on the lightning masts, turtles at the vents and the ruined breakwater, and the intake hatch down to the Drowned Relay.

name: Drowned Relay
role: Thalassia's dungeon: a flooded Aethrion signal station under the seabed, round the Signalmind's Sonar Chamber.

name: Vaelspire
role: Region capital: research city with services, quest hub, crafting, the cable lift to Snowcoil and transit to Port Merrow and Cindervale.

name: Frostline
role: First field: the treeline where pines give way to snow; passive mites on the thaw strip, fleeing hares, wisps over the lake.

name: Blueglass Ridge
role: A knife-edge ridge of blue volcanic glass held by Glassback Ram flocks: on the terraces, among the crystal spines, in the windscour drifts and round the obelisks.

name: Snowcoil
role: A valley wound with frozen Aethrion coolant coils: the serpent horde in the trenches and gear walkers at the pump yard and on the lower slopes. The cable lift from Vaelspire arrives here.

name: Prism Pass
role: A high pass through prism-crystal cliffs: Archive Keepers in the hollow, at the outer vault doors and along the plough road, and the Glacier Juggernaut elite.

name: Mirror Ice
role: A frozen lake polished to a mirror: reflections that heal on the open ice and the lens islands, and great passive grazers on the shore.

name: White Circuit
role: The region's last field: a ring conduit buried under a glacier, guarded by sentries, with specters leaking from the breach by the Archive door and haunting the snowdrifts.

name: Cryocore Archive
role: Crystallis's dungeon: the frozen Aethrion archive of data-cores and cryo wards round the Curator's Vault.

name: Cindervale
role: Region capital: services, quest hub, crafting, transit to Emberfall fields, Vaelspire and Umbracrest.

name: Ashfield
role: First field: passive grazers on open ash and the crust ridge, assisting slag toads in the pools and round the heat-sink vents; the warm-up from Crystallis.

name: Cinder Track
role: The old haul road climbing north over a lava stream: the first aggressive horde, Cinder Imps on the terraces, in the hollows, on the scree and along the rail trestles.

name: Forge Approach
role: The industrial causeway north of Cindervale: iron bridges over lava channels, the hound kennels and the cold forges.

name: Magma Vents
role: A broken plain of live vents: the skink horde round the vent pool, Spitters on the fissure, skinks and Spitters together on the heat-tap ridge.

name: Ironfall
role: A canyon split by a lava river and crossed by two Aethrion iron spans; Knights hold the truss graveyard, Scraplings strip the girders.

name: Red Crucible
role: The last field: a ring road round the Crucible's slag lake, wraiths in the pour channels, Brutes in the mould yard, the hatch to Furnace Zero.

name: Furnace Zero
role: Emberfall's dungeon: the first Aethrion furnace, its pour gallery, coal pens and stoker halls, all worked by Zero Stokers, round Kiln Prime's Zero Core.

name: Umbracrest
role: Region capital: services, quest hub, crafting, transit to Nocthaven fields and Cindervale.

name: Dusk Verge
role: First field: the collapsed outskirts. Passive wisps on the boulevard and the fallen overpass, lurk packs in the underpass, both mixed in the conduit square.

name: Nullgarden
role: A city park gone colourless: Nullbloom beds and black glasshouses, haulers on the promenade and round the dead pond.

name: Silent Tracks
role: The elevated rail yards east of Umbracrest: mite crews in the sidings and on the stalled line, drones on the signal gantries.

name: Veil Rift
role: A district torn by a rift in the Veil: Riftlings swarm both banks of the chasm, the tilted blocks and the spires above.

name: Black Array
role: A receiver field of dishes and lattice masts still listening to the Meridian Lattice; sentinels ring the great dish and pace the control lines, Sparkwing flocks roost on the dishes and masts.

name: Meridian Gate
role: The last field: the monumental gate where Nocthaven's lattice lines converge. Glyph swarms on the plaza, colonnade and verge, the Executor court, and the sealed descent to the Heart.

name: Lattice Heart
role: Nocthaven's dungeon and the game's last: hexagonal conduits round the Lattice Sovereign's chamber.
